## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change. If this does two things, it should be two pull requests.
- [ ] Consistent with the [Constitution](../constitution/CONSTITUTION.md) and the existing specifications.
- [ ] No new claim about privacy, availability, deletion or censorship-resistance that the design cannot actually deliver.
- [ ] No new privileged party, default intermediary, treasury or token.
- [ ] Documentation lint passes (fenced blocks have a language tag; no wrapped line starts with `*` or `+`).
- [ ] Cross-document constants still agree (durations, ports, thresholds, field names, TLD list).
